fieldNotes.location: Confirmed at 3501 Paseo del Norte NE, Albuquerque - a General Mills cereal manufacturing plant. Roster geocode moved 2,485m and resolved correctly onto the plant; verified by web search (Rio Rancho/Bernalillo Chamber, D&B - grain & oilseed milling / breakfast cereal).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled entrance off the SE access road from Paseo del Norte. A guard-booth island sits in the center of the entry roadway; the road splits around it. Gate / barrier crosshatch markings visible at the road entry into the trailer yard.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small staffed booth (~1-2 vehicle footprint) on a raised concrete median island mid-roadway at the entrance, windows / roof structure visible in z20-z21 imagery - a classic guarded entry island.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large open paved areas inside the gate (ring road and yard pavement) provide ample internal queue/holding room before the docks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: The entry roadway and ring-road apron are very wide with abundant unused paved width around the guard island - room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors on the W building face (~8-10 trailers backed in) and an N-face notch (~6-8 trailers backed in), plus additional truck bays; total estimated 25-50 band. Exact count uncertain - many doors obscured by building inset geometry.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large trailer drop yards on the W and NW of the property - dozens of trailers parked in marked rows (well over 50). dropYard=true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock clusters on different building faces (W face and N-face notch) suggest separate shipping/receiving operations - medium confidence.
fieldNotes.railServed: Active rail spurs curve into the property on the N and E sides with railcars positioned on-site (grain/cereal inbound).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the Albuquerque metro fabric (industrial/business-park district off Paseo del Norte, a major arterial) - Urban.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single combined entry/exit roadway split by the guard island; lane count not crisply countable - estimated 1/1.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One very large interconnected plant complex (counted as 2 to reflect the main building plus an attached secondary wing); single campus, multipleFacilities=false.
